verdict.rationale: Netlify is a deployment and hosting platform, so multi-protocol serving is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence only shows HTTP/HTTPS web hosting and serverless functions. Nothing documents TCP, gRPC, or WebSocket traffic, or serving all four protocols from one service without separate protocol configuration, so the core capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve HTTP, TCP, gRPC, and WebSocket traffic from the same deployed service without separate protocol configuration
